widgets_values: Style: cinematic-realistic educational infographic. The image is a wide 16:9 historical timeline about artificial intelligence, arranged as a museum-style wall display with a dark navy-to-black gradient background, subtle vignette lighting, and warm spotlight illumination from above. Across the top center, a large cream-white Chinese title reads "AI发展历史说明书", set in bold, clean sans-serif lettering with a slight glow and shadow. Beneath it, a thin horizontal divider line stretches across most of the width, separating the header from the timeline content. The main composition uses a left-to-right chronological flow with connected circular nodes, pale connector lines, and alternating portrait panels on both sides of the central text blocks. At the far left near the upper section, a black-and-white rectangular portrait shows Alan Turing in side profile, cropped from the chest upward, wearing a suit jacket and tie; he appears as a middle-aged white man with short dark hair, a serious expression, and strong contrast lighting. To his right, the first milestone contains the date "1950" in large light-gray numerals, followed by the heading "图灵测试提出" and the body text "图灵提出“机器能思考吗？”的问题，并设计图灵测试作为判断机器智能的标准。". A thin vertical divider separates this block from the next one. Near the upper middle-left, another black-and-white portrait shows John McCarthy, an older white man with glasses, neatly combed hair, and a thoughtful expression, facing slightly to the right. Beside him, the second milestone displays "1956", the heading "达特茅斯会议", and the body text "达特茅斯会议召开，“人工智能”一词正式诞生，标志着AI学科的开端。". In the upper center-right, a smaller black-and-white portrait depicts Marvin Minsky, an older white man with glasses and a suit, shown in a frontal three-quarter view. The adjacent third milestone reads "1960s-1970s", then "专家系统兴起", followed by "基于规则的专家系统被开发出来，AI在特定领域开始展现实用价值。". Farther right, a fourth black-and-white portrait shows Joseph Weizenbaum, an older white man with glasses and a calm expression, placed before the milestone labeled "1980s", with the heading "专家系统应用" and the body text "专家系统在医疗、金融等领域得到应用，推动AI技术走向商业化。".
